segments.zh: 苹果第一台折叠屏刚开卖，
segments.en: Apple's first foldable just went on sale,

segments.zh: 热搜就被一层膜承包了。
segments.en: and one thin film took over the trending list.

segments.zh: 有人发现，内屏那层磨砂膜，
segments.en: People found the matte film on the inner screen
peels off by hand.

segments.zh: 撕完想贴回去？官方售后398元。
segments.en: Want it back on? 398 yuan at Apple service.

segments.zh: 要是把屏弄坏了，据报道换内屏将近八千。
segments.en: Damage the screen, and a new one reportedly costs nearly 8,000.
It starts at 15,999 yuan in China,

segments.zh: 这层膜成了全网最贵的一张贴纸。
segments.en: and this film became the internet's priciest sticker.
Today's question: how can a sheet of glass
fold in half?
Meet Foldy.
A phone that bends in half.
Would you dare fold
an ordinary phone's glass?
Crack.

segments.zh: 玻璃很硬，可是一弯就碎。
segments.en: Glass is hard, but it snaps when bent.
Why? Because when you bend something,
the outside has to stretch.
And glass hates stretching:

segments.zh: 表面一道看不见的小裂纹，一拉就裂开。
segments.en: one invisible tiny flaw, and it rips open.
The secret is one formula:

segments.zh: 弯的时候，表面拉长的比例，约等于厚度除以两倍的弯曲半径。
segments.en: bend something, and its surface stretches by about thickness over twice the bend radius.
In plain words:
the thinner it is, the more it can bend.
You can't fold a whole book,
but a single page folds easily.

segments.zh: 我们粗算一下：0.5毫米的普通玻璃，
segments.en: Our rough math: half-millimeter glass

segments.zh: 弯到半径2毫米，表面要拉长大约12%。
segments.en: bent to a 2-millimeter radius would stretch about 12 percent.
But glass breaks
at roughly 1 percent stretch.

segments.zh: 所以折叠屏用的是超薄玻璃，
segments.en: So foldables use ultra-thin glass,
often around 30 microns.
That's half the thickness
of a human hair.
Bent to the same 2 millimeters,
it stretches less than 1 percent.
Same glass.

segments.zh: 薄到一定程度，就从“碎”变成了“弯”。
segments.en: Make it thin enough, and 'shatter' becomes 'bend'.
Twist one: that thin,
glass turns floppy like paper.
But it's also delicate.
It hates scratches and pokes.

segments.zh: 所以最上面要盖一层保护层。
segments.en: So a protective layer sits on top.
That film you peeled is its armor.

segments.zh: 反转二：屏幕是好多层叠在一起的，
segments.en: Twist two: the screen is a stack of layers,
like a layer cake.
When it bends, the outside stretches
and the inside squeezes.

segments.zh: 中间有一层，不拉也不挤，
segments.en: In between, one layer does neither.
It's called the neutral layer.
Like folding a magazine:

segments.zh: 封面被拉，封底被挤，中间的书页最轻松。
segments.en: the cover stretches, the back squeezes, the middle pages relax.

segments.zh: 工程师把最怕拉的东西，
segments.en: Engineers tuck the most fragile parts
as close to that layer as they can.

segments.zh: 撕掉一层，整叠的厚度就变了，
segments.en: Peel one layer, and the stack changes thickness.
The neutral layer moves too.
That's our guess:

segments.zh: 时间长了，里面可能多受一点力。
segments.en: over time, the inside might take a bit more strain.

segments.zh: 按常见折叠屏的结构，最外面那层专门挡划痕。
segments.en: In a typical foldable, the outermost layer takes the scratches.

segments.zh: 撕了，下面那层就直接见人了。
segments.en: Peel it, and the layer below faces the world bare.
Twist three, the weird one:

segments.zh: 撕了膜，屏幕反而更亮、更清楚。
segments.en: peel it off and the screen looks brighter and sharper.
Because a matte surface is like frosted glass.
It scatters light in every direction.
Less glare,

segments.zh: 可画面也蒙上了一点雾。
segments.en: but a slight haze over the picture.
Peel it, and the surface turns glossy,
reflecting like a mirror.
Matte means diffuse reflection.
Glossy means mirror reflection.

segments.zh: 而镜子会把每一点起伏都照出来，
segments.en: And a mirror shows every tiny bump,
including the crease down the middle.
So that matte film
was also hiding the crease.
That's why,

segments.zh: 撕膜以后，很多人说折痕更明显了。
segments.en: after peeling, many people say the crease got more obvious.

segments.zh: 有商家说这台手机没技术含量？
segments.en: A reseller says this phone has no real tech in it?

segments.zh: 光这一层膜，就有这么多讲究。
segments.en: This one film alone holds all of this.

segments.zh: 据报道，有人把它折了三万两千多次，
segments.en: One reported test folded it over 32,000 times,
with no noticeable change.

segments.zh: 折叠屏最难的从来不是“折”，
segments.en: The hard part of a foldable was never folding.

segments.zh: 而是折几万次以后还能平。
segments.en: It's staying flat after tens of thousands of folds.

segments.zh: 友情提示：膜不是不能撕，
segments.en: Friendly fine print: you can peel it,
but you can't un-peel it.
Want glossy? Do the math first:
398 yuan, versus a nearly 8,000-yuan screen.
Foldy says:

segments.zh: 我能对折，但请别撕我的铠甲。
segments.en: I can bend in half, but please don't peel my armor.
